classification.difficultyReason: The formula S_n = n/2(a+ℓ) is given and S_n = 0 is set directly into it. The only decision is to justify why n/2 can be dropped (n is positive, so the other factor must be zero) and then state ℓ = -a. This is one short reasoning step with a verbal explanation, so it is a little above direct substitution (A2). It is below p21-q4, which needs a number of terms found and then a sum evaluated across several linked steps, and below p27-q14, which needs two conditions solved together.
